fact: Farmerline says a five-year MoU signed with the Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation on 12 June 2024 commits it to use high-resolution satellite imagery for boundary delineation, tree counting, deforestation tracking and monitoring illegal mining, for better decisions in agriculture.

Sierraloaded reports the Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security launched a weather index insurance scheme with Activa, SLICOM and UNCDF that uses satellite monitoring of weather to trigger payouts, piloted in 3 districts for rice and maize.
